title: Oaklands Swim Club

services.name: Guests & Rentals
services.desc: Your guests are always welcome at Oaklands. The fee for each guest regardless of age is $8. Each guest must be accompanied by a member aged 14 or older. Exception - A member aged 12 to 14 may bring one guest aged 12 or older provided the guest passes the deep water test. See Pool Rules for more information. The pool is available for rental by members for private parties. These parties may held during or after regular pool hours. We would ask that you please try to schedule at least one week (7 days) in advance in order to allow time to schedule guards.
